# I NEED TO LOCK IN

# Locked in
## what did i do today
so today i was able to work a lot more than yesterday . today i made some changes in schematics  i started to work on footprint for the capacitive  touch gave them a custom shape also  made library to assign it. after that i worked on making the pcb first i arranged the parts and used f.cuts layer to make a custom guitar shape and arranged accordingly after that i routed the pcb . also i messed up the routing first time had to do it again.i downloaded the 3d models for parts and changed them to give a good quality render.after that i added few custom silkscreens related to kanye. i feel like these  hours were worth it.
